//: Story Phase 14 world scripts: the Brogath Rules board, the Fart-Free Zone (rest, sign, table), inspections of everything the phase leaves behind, Brogath's wandering in the end state.

then: The Brogath Rules. A sheet of parchment pinned to the underside of the tipped card table, in Pete's capitals.
The Brogath Rules. Two sheets now, nailed one under the other. Pete has started numbering them.
The Brogath Rules. Three sheets, and a fourth started. Somebody has added a little drawing of a napkin, crossed out.
The Brogath Rules. Four sheets, down to the floor, with a ribbon at the bottom to stop the last one curling. The ribbon is nailed down. It isn't allowed to flutter.

p14.zone_rest: The mattress. Folded in half, against the back wall, under the stairs. It smells of nothing at all.

then: You lie down for a while. Nobody farts. It's the best sleep you've had since the treasure room.

p14.inspect.zone_sign: The sign on the inside of the door, in Bob's paint: FART-FREE ZONE. Underneath: THIS MEANS GARRICK. Underneath that, smaller: AND HIM.

then: And underneath that, in Pete's hand, newer: NO TELEVISIONS.
The candle, the cards, a jug of Frog Grog with a plate over it. This is the only table on the ship where the cards are allowed to flutter. Somebody always throws them, when they come in.
else: The little table. One candle. Enough light for a pocket edition, if you hold it close.

p14.inspect.zone_mops: Mops. Buckets. A broom with no bristles. Nobody has been in this cupboard for years. Nobody has farted in it, either. Ever.

then: And under it, Pete's sums. MONTHS: 3-6. GARRICK FARTS ALLOWED: 0. GARRICK'S RECORD: 1 DAY. And yours, underneath: THE SAFE DISPOSAL PLAN IS IMPOSSIBLE.

p14.inspect.slate: Nobody's rubbed it off. Nobody's going to.
p14.inspect.treasure_door: The treasure-room door. Planked again, twice over, and the planks nailed down by Gristle with more nails than wood.
DO NOT OPEN. YES, SERIOUSLY. BAD CLOUD. DANGEROUS CLOUD INSIDE. CAPTAIN: THIS MEANS YOU. (That one is underlined now.)
Behind it, the old cloud growls. It's lost a plume. It doesn't sound as if it's missed it.

p14.inspect.exclusion_sign.caption: BROGATH NEVER GOES NEAR THE TREASURE ROOM.

p14.inspect.exclusion_sign: BROGATH NEVER GOES NEAR THE TREASURE ROOM. (THIS IS FOR HIS OWN GOOD.)

then: Somebody has added, in an elegant, ancient and slightly hurt hand: I WOULDN'T ANYWAY.

p14.inspect.nook_cupboard: A little door in the planking under the stairs, half your height. The mop cupboard. You've walked past it a thousand times.
p14.inspect.crate: The Grand Currency crate. GRAND STENCHMASTER GRAND TOKENS OF GRAND CURRENCY. NOT LEGAL TENDER. THIS WAY UP. It isn't this way up any more.
captain[resigned]: ({num:grand_currency_tokens} of them. Minus the ones in my boots.)

then: Squawks has made a nest in the top of it. Bad money. Comfortable, though.

p14.inspect.tokens_deck: A Grand Token, in the scuppers. Another one, wedged in the deck seam. NOT LEGAL TENDER. They're coming from the crate. They're coming from EVERYWHERE.
p14.inspect.tokens_galley: Grand Tokens, under the bench. Jim found one in the soup this morning, and one in the bread, and one in Gristle.
p14.inspect.tokens_quarters: A little heap of Grand Tokens in the corner. Brogath has been 'saving'. He calls it his reserve.
p14.inspect.oats_galley: Oats. In the cracks between the floorboards. Weeks after. You'll be finding oats in this galley for the rest of your life.

then: (One sack went into the Sharkstorm. It has not come back. Everything comes back. It has not come back. Nobody likes to think about why.)

p14.inspect.scorch: A scorched ring on the floorboards, round where he stood the night he came back. 'Little toot,' he said.
p14.inspect.porthole: The porthole cracked in the first eruption, stuffed with a sash pillow ever since. When the wind gets up, the pillow whistles. It isn't allowed to flutter. It whistles.
p14.inspect.vault: The vault door. Round. Steel. Set into thin air. It growls, now and then, satisfied. There is no handle on this side.
p14.inspect.bank_forms: Forms in racks. GRAND DEPOSIT. GRAND WITHDRAWAL. ATMOSPHERIC ASSET TRANSFER. And a long one in very small print: DISCLOSURE OF FART-BACKED HOLDINGS (THE GRAND TRUST ACCEPTS NO LIABILITY FOR WINDAGE).
p14.inspect.bank_sign: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST. YOUR GAS IS OUR BUSINESS! In gold leaf, on green, hanging from nothing at all.
p14.inspect.bank_gone: Where the counter was, there's a row of little scorch marks on the deck, and one form that didn't dissolve: GRAND WITHDRAWAL. It's blank. It will always be blank.
